about_the_game:
• Top-down PvP / PvE survival crafter sandbox

  • 100+ player dedicated servers

  • Survive and find prestige in the brutal primal world

  • Explore, Loot, Craft, and Build

  • Claim land, fortify and defend your territory. Raid or collaborate with other players

  • Recruit multiple survivors; skill up with new abilities, and specialize

  • Science, Faith, Culture, and Combat progression paths

  • Prestige leaderboard categories like "Solo with the highest science", "Quad with the most territory"

Before industry, before empire, before law - there was only the primal, pain, predators, and those with the will to outlast them.

You are barefoot, alone, exposed. No map. No mission. Just wilderness - ancient, and hostile.

First, you'll fight to stay warm. To not become something's lunch. Then, you'll rush to settle - to fortify, to grow your numbers, to raise defenses. And finally: to choose. Exist and endure - or to specialize and exceed?

"There is no one way to victory, yet it is always forwards."

Before is an online survival sandbox game - open-world, unforgiving, risky, and rewarding. An experience forged in the primal.

Survival

Blood, sweat, and strategy are the cost of tomorrow.

The wilderness wants you gone. So do the animals. So do the nomads. So do the other players, most of the time.

Your survivors must eat, drink, sleep, stay warm, or die trying.

Crafting

Tools, weapons, and resources are the backbone of survival.

Arm your survivors with handaxes, bows, simple spears, and perhaps, with enough skill, swords or even explosives. Forge defenses with reinforced doors, traps, and siege gear. Mine and smelt ores to craft stronger equipment and extend your tribe’s might.

Base Building

Build from the dirt up with foundations, walls, traps, and defensive towers.

Every construction piece placed is a tactical decision. Every structure built is a home, a statement, a foothold, a safe haven, or a deception in stone.

PvP with Real Consequences

Raiding is unavoidable. Preventing it is power.

Weak walls falter. Weak settlements fall. Weak strategies fail.

But place your trust in yourself, your allies, your architecture, your automated defenses, and above all - your foresight - and you may survive the night. Perhaps you'll even come to command the raiders.

Four and More Paths to Fame

Upgrade each of your survivors in unique and invaluable combinations of specializations.

  • Science - Study your surroundings to gain knowledge and unlock new technologies.

  • Faith - Sacrifice, pray, and channel the ether to manipulate the world around you and increase your following.

  • Culture - Unify your tribe, manipulate others, and harness the game-changing powers of arts and the written word.

  • Combat - Fight and dominate to unlock unique skills and tactics for battlefield prowess.

Each discipline brings new abilities, but power invites envy. Your survivors, painstakingly trained and specialized, are not invincible. Mismanage your might, and you'll become someone else's prize.

Primal Strategy

Before is not just about survival. It's about defining your little corner of the world. Or perhaps owning all of it.

  • Explore: Move through unique biomes, weather systems, ruins, settlements, and stories.

  • Develop: Build new bases, expand borders, found your tribe - or tribes, deceive, infiltrate, manipulate, conquer, or command.

  • Produce: Mine rare ores, claim choke points, automate production and survivors' actions.

  • Overpower: Rob, raid, siege or ambush. Or build defenses that vanquish and absorb the armies of others.

  • Endure or Exceed: Act as a territorial overlord, the right hand of powerful allies, or a rebel beyond everyone's reach.

Prestige Has a Memory

Eventually, the map will wipe. The fray will end. After each wipe a new sun will rise, a new land will be there for your taking. And you will be readier for it.

Nonetheless, your actions are forever.

→ Which tribe held the most territory?

→ Who mined the most riches?

→ Who had the oldest surviving settlement?

→ Who ruled in Science? Faith? Culture? Combat?

→ Which solos/duos/trios/quads/clans were the most powerful? Influential?

→ Who crafted the most? Who traded the most?

There are many paths to prestige.

As the world turns, the leaderboard will count your successes. And when the world resets, your fame will remain.

  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: Survive a brutal primal world on 100-player, Top-Down PvP/PvE servers. If you last long enough: craft tools, settle, and recruit new survivors. If you're still not eaten, or raided: Specialize in Science, Faith, Culture, or Combat - and plan your way to prestige...
